Evidence / CLM-035
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?2024 reference year compared in the CBY-Aden Annual Reports 2024 and 2025.

The apparent balance between remittances and donor financing changes between editions of the annual report

01What does this evidence establish?

Using two balance-of-payments items of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), labelled by the source as remittances and donor financing, within the same annual-report edition, the 2024 remittance-to-donor-financing ratio is 1.78 in the 2024 annual report and 0.98 after the 2025 annual report restates 2024. The comparison is limited to those exact labels, not all aid or external finance.

01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The ratio of the remittance item to the donor-financing item for the 2024 reference year, calculated within each of two editions of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) annual report.

03Who or what does it apply to?

Two balance-of-payments items of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), labelled by the source as remittances and donor financing, within each annual-report edition; not all aid, official development assistance (ODA) or external finance

04How current is it?

The comparison refers to the 2024 reference year as published in the 2024 and 2025 annual reports. It is recalculated if either item is revised in a later annual report.

05What this evidence does not establish

The ratio does not describe all aid, official development assistance or external finance, and it does not rank flows that are defined differently.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Computed by this resource within each annual-report edition: the 2024 remittance item divided by the 2024 donor-financing item, both as labelled and published in that edition (the 2024 annual report, and the 2025 annual report with its restated 2024 values).

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
